name: Reconcile_GetCluster
note: GET response; retain this reconcile snapshot.

name: UpdateResourceStatus
guards: LET c == [s.op.cluster EXCEPT !.readyCount=Cardinality(s.op.ready), !.target=IF @#s.op.cluster.current /\ (s.op.ready={} \/ @ \notin s.op.active) THEN s.op.cluster.current ELSE @] IN (c=s.op.cluster \/ s.op.cluster.rv=s.cluster.rv)
updates: LET c == [s.op.cluster EXCEPT !.readyCount=Cardinality(s.op.ready), !.target=IF @#s.op.cluster.current /\ (s.op.ready={} \/ @ \notin s.op.active) THEN s.op.cluster.current ELSE @] IN IF c=s.op.cluster THEN s.cluster ELSE [c EXCEPT !.rv=ClusterRV]

LET c == [s.op.cluster EXCEPT !.readyCount=Cardinality(s.op.ready), !.target=IF @#s.op.cluster.current /\ (s.op.ready={} \/ @ \notin s.op.active) THEN s.op.cluster.current ELSE @] IN IF c=s.op.cluster THEN c ELSE [c EXCEPT !.rv=ClusterRV]
note: Ready count is refreshed by EnrichStatus before testing target activity; a no-op does not refresh the caller.

name: UpdateResourceStatus_Conflict
note: A conflicting status update retries the reconcile; other legitimate status fields may have changed.

name: MarkOldPrimaryAsUnhealthy
note: Routing label only. Existing SQL and replication sessions are retained.

name: GetReplicaStatusFromPodViaHTTP
updates: IF s.env.http[n] /\ Manager(n) /\ DBReady(n) THEN [ok |-> TRUE, primary |-> s.data[n].diskRole="primary", receiver |-> Receiver(n), received |-> s.data[n].received, replayed |-> s.data[n].replayed] ELSE EmptyHTTP
note: One HTTP observation at a time in Pod-name order; errors have zero receiver/LSN fields.

name: EvaluatePodReadinessGuards
updates: IF s.op.active={} THEN "idle" ELSE LET b==Best(s.op.active) IN IF Cardinality(ObservedPrimaries)>1 \/ (s.op.http[b].ok /\ b\notin s.op.ready) \/ (s.op.cluster.current=s.op.cluster.target /\ s.op.cluster.current\in s.op.ready /\ ~s.op.http[s.op.cluster.current].ok) THEN "idle" ELSE "choose"

name: ReconcileTargetPrimaryForNonReplicaCluster
updates: LET b==Best(s.op.active) IN IF s.op.cluster.target=b \/ ~s.op.http[b].ok THEN "idle" ELSE IF s.op.cluster.current=s.op.cluster.target /\ FailoverQuorumEnabled THEN "quorumGet" ELSE "failoverPhaseGet"
note: Failover-delay policy is an elapsed precondition of this step; no fixed-latency claim is checked.

name: EvaluateQuorumCheck_Get
note: Operator informer read; instance-manager quorum reads below are direct API reads.

name: DeliverFailoverQuorum
note: Deliver latest real object; old observation remains valid until delivery.

name: UpdatePrimaryPod_Select
note: Supported rolling/drain selection; no manual promotion override. Selected receiver must be active.

name: RegisterPhase_Get
updates: IF s.op.pc="failoverPhaseGet" THEN "failoverPhasePatch" ELSE IF s.op.pc="plannedPhaseGet" THEN "plannedPhasePatch" ELSE "selectedPhasePatch"

name: RegisterPhase_Patch
updates: IF s.op.phaseRead.phase=(IF s.op.purpose="planned" THEN "switchover" ELSE "failover") THEN s.cluster ELSE [s.cluster EXCEPT !.phase=IF s.op.purpose="planned" THEN "switchover" ELSE "failover", !.rv=ClusterRV]

IF s.op.phaseRead.phase=(IF s.op.purpose="planned" THEN "switchover" ELSE "failover") THEN s.op.cluster ELSE [s.cluster EXCEPT !.phase=IF s.op.purpose="planned" THEN "switchover" ELSE "failover", !.rv=ClusterRV]
note: Conditional patch refreshes caller status on change; no-op preserves caller snapshot.

name: RegisterPhase_Conflict
updates: IF s.op.pc="failoverPhasePatch" THEN "failoverPhaseGet" ELSE IF s.op.pc="plannedPhasePatch" THEN "plannedPhaseGet" ELSE "selectedPhaseGet"

name: SetPrimaryInstance_Pending
note: Merge patch of target only; no added optimistic precondition.

name: AreWalReceiversDown
note: Uses the already-collected sequential HTTP snapshot, not new reads.

name: VerifyPgDataCoherenceForPrimary
note: Startup permission is not coupled to any lease read or acquisition.

name: VerifyPgDataCoherenceForPrimary_Archive
updates: IF ArchiveEnabled THEN s.archive \cup {[timeline |-> s.data[n].timeline, prefix |-> s.data[n].durable]} ELSE s.archive

name: Rewind_Demote
note: Rewind is completed before any standby start; disk durability is retained across earlier crashes.

name: RunPostgresAndWait
note: Actual postmaster start occurs after initialization, before reconcilePrimary.

name: InstanceIsReady
note: The readiness guard precedes both promotion and old-primary retirement.

name: Acquire
updates: IF s.elect[n].captured=0 THEN [s.elect[n] EXCEPT !.captured=s.inst[n].snapshot.leaseGeneration, !.pc="preGet", !.pollAge=0] ELSE s.elect[n]
note: Only the first call captures the lease profile. Caller timeout does not cancel the runnable.

name: Acquire_Return
note: Closed heldCh is a one-shot notification, not a fresh ownership predicate.

name: Acquire_Deadline
note: Caller retry is separate from the background preAcquire goroutine.

name: WaitForWalReceiverDown
note: Checks the selected node itself, even if operator HTTP receiver fields were unavailable.

name: PromoteAndWait_Request
note: pg_ctl promotion request; PostgreSQL finishes available WAL before the physical role changes.

name: PromoteAndWait_Complete
updates: s.history \cup {[node |-> n, retained |-> s.data[n].durable, fork |-> s.data[n].replayed, acks |-> s.acks, cleanFrom |-> s.elect[n].cleanFrom, cleanAcks |-> s.elect[n].cleanAcks, timeline |-> <<n,s.data[n].replayed>>]}
note: Missing archive successor is an observed end-of-WAL, not proof the previous primary finished archiving.

name: ReconcilePrimary_CompleteStatus
updates: IF s.inst[n].snapshot.current=n THEN s.cluster ELSE [s.cluster EXCEPT !.current=n, !.rv=ClusterRV]
note: Merge patch of currentPrimary; source has no fresh target/version precondition.

name: ReconcileOldPrimary
updates: IF s.inst[n].snapshot.target#n /\ s.data[n].diskRole="primary" THEN [s.life[n] EXCEPT !.cause="demotion", !.phase="requested", !.stopAge=0] ELSE s.life[n]
note: Send lifecycle command and wait. Demotion never reuses heldCh in the same manager process.

name: ReconcileConfiguration
updates: IF s.inst[n].reloadNeeded THEN IF ManageQuorum(n) THEN "resetGet" ELSE "reload" ELSE "metadata"

name: Reload
note: pg_ctl reload request is separate from runtime application.

name: ProcessConfigReloadAndManageRestart
note: Successful observed config hash; no historical hash-check regression is modeled.

name: GetSynchronousReplicationMetadata
updates: IF ManageQuorum(n) THEN [EmptyQuorum EXCEPT !.primary=n, !.members=s.data[n].runtimeConfig.members\{n}, !.number=s.data[n].runtimeConfig.number, !.generation=s.data[n].runtimeConfig.generation, !.timeline=s.data[n].timeline] ELSE EmptyQuorum
note: Read runtime metadata once before conflict retries; provenance is diagnostic, not an extra guard.

name: UpdateFailoverQuorumObject_Update
updates: IF [s.quorum EXCEPT !.rv=0]=s.inst[n].metadata THEN s.quorum ELSE [s.inst[n].metadata EXCEPT !.rv=QuorumRV]

name: TryTakeOver_OwnHolder
note: Own-holder observation is accepted without first renewing.

name: TryTakeOver_ForeignHolder
note: Foreign record uses the candidate captured duration. No retirement occurs in this branch, even after a previous acquisition.

name: Claim
note: Conditional API update. Only a matching resourceVersion can succeed.

name: RunLeaderElection_FirstAcquired
note: heldCh closes before le.Run calls its own acquire, and never reopens in this process.

name: LeaderElection_Check
note: Unlike tryTakeOver, client-go uses the observed record duration; the fresh first foreign read always starts a new observation window.

name: RunLeaderElection_RenewDeadline
note: Expiry of an existing renewal timer is reactive; this is not an injected failed renewal.

name: ClassifyLeaseAfterRun_Unverifiable
note: No evidence of preemption: retry; enabled isolation remains independent.

name: ClassifyLeaseAfterRun_Preempted
note: Terminal error cancels the manager; it does not synchronously kill PostgreSQL.

name: TryShuttingDownSmartFast_Checkpoint
note: Request/checkpoint boundary precedes any signal that stops accepting SQL.

name: Shutdown_StopRequest
note: Fast mode stops existing transactions. Smart mode can leave preexisting sessions writing; a cancelled checkpoint returns without proving SQL retirement.

name: TryShuttingDownSmartFast_Fallback
note: Fast fallback retains the configured maxStopDelay; no old implicit 60-second timeout is modeled.

name: Shutdown_ClientsFinished
note: All writers have retired; a clean shutdown now finishes WAL flush/archive.

name: Shutdown_ArchiveComplete
updates: IF ArchiveEnabled THEN s.archive\cup {[timeline |-> s.data[n].timeline, prefix |-> s.data[n].durable]} ELSE s.archive

name: RunPostgresAndWait_Exit
guards: s.life[n].immediate \/ (\A r\in Server:Running(r) /\ s.data[r].receiver=n /\ s.env.wal[r] => Prefix(s.data[n].durable,s.sent[r]))

name: PostgresLifecycle_Return
note: Ordinary SIGTERM and demotion reach manager cancellation only after lifecycle return.

name: ManagerStart_Return
note: Runnable completion and manager grace expiry are different explanations for return.

name: Release_Update
updates: [s.lease EXCEPT !.holder=None, !.duration=IF s.elect[n].captured=0 THEN LeaseProfiles[1].released ELSE LeaseProfiles[s.elect[n].captured].released, !.rv=LeaseRV, !.renew=LeaseRV, !.cleanFrom=n, !.cleanAcks=IF s.life[n].immediate THEN {} ELSE AckRecords(n)]
note: No PostgreSQL-exit/archive-completion guard exists here. Clean evidence is recorded, not asserted.

name: Release_Error
note: The defer makes one attempt; a foreign-holder read instead takes Release_Check.

name: Run_ContainerExit
note: Normal Pod namespace teardown stops remaining postmaster processes. It does not imply archiving completed.

name: IsHealthy_GetCluster
note: Direct API probe result, separate from the instance informer cache.

name: IsHealthy_IsolationProbe
updates: IF ~s.life[n].isolationAPI /\ ~s.life[n].isolationPeers /\ s.life[n].cause="none" THEN [s.life[n] EXCEPT !.cause="isolation", !.phase="requested", !.stopAge=0, !.isolationPC="idle"] ELSE [s.life[n] EXCEPT !.isolationPC="idle"]
note: Threshold-completed kubelet probe abstraction. API success compensates peer failure; retirement follows the SIGTERM order.

name: TryShuttingDownFastImmediate_Immediate
note: Current immediate fallback is retained. Loss after explicit immediate shutdown is excluded from clean-archive promises.

name: TryShuttingDownSmartFast_StopTimeout
note: Configured maxStopDelay expires: pg_ctl returns an error; lifecycle return still does not prove PostgreSQL exit.

name: GenerateWAL
note: Client request introduces a unique normalized WAL identity; an unacknowledged request is not protected.

name: FlushWAL
guards: IF s.data[n].diskRole="primary" THEN s.data[n].durable#s.data[n].generated ELSE s.data[n].durable#s.data[n].received
updates: IF s.data[n].diskRole="primary" THEN s.data[n].generated ELSE s.data[n].received
note: PostgreSQL durable flush; a required synchronous ack cannot use merely received or sent WAL.

name: SendWAL
note: WAL sender snapshot; sent is separate from receiver flush and replay.

name: AcknowledgeCommit
guards: \A r\in witnesses : Running(r) /\ s.data[r].receiver=n /\ s.env.wal[r] /\ s.data[r].timeline=s.data[n].timeline /\ Prefix(s.data[n].durable,s.data[r].durable)
updates: s.acks\cup {[primary |-> n, prefix |-> s.data[n].durable, timeline |-> s.data[n].timeline, members |-> s.data[n].runtimeConfig.members, number |-> s.data[n].runtimeConfig.number, generation |-> s.data[n].runtimeConfig.generation, witnesses |-> witnesses, copies |-> [r\in witnesses |-> s.data[r].durable]]}
note: Client observes a durable synchronous commit. Required number never shrinks when a standby becomes unavailable.

name: ArchiveWAL
updates: IF ArchiveEnabled THEN s.archive\cup {[timeline |-> s.data[n].timeline, prefix |-> s.data[n].durable]} ELSE s.archive

name: RestoreArchiveWAL
note: Restore precedes durable flush/replay; missing next archive record permits promotion.

name: WalReceiverDown
note: A normal drained stream consumes sent WAL before exit; transport failure can disconnect without a final prefix.

name: WalReceiverConnect
note: New connections obey -rw labels; existing streams are not severed by a label patch.

name: ReconcileMetadata
note: Normal label convergence remains enabled after successful handoff.

name: RequestPlannedSwitchover
note: Rollout/drain stimulus, not a direct target patch.

name: OnlineUpgrade_Exec
note: Process replacement keeps PostgreSQL and disk state; new runnable has a new heldCh.

name: PodCrash
note: Abrupt process loss does not clean-release or erase durable WAL/disk role.

name: PodRestart
note: Restart resets volatile PCs/acquisition/observation clocks while retaining disk configuration, WAL and role.

name: PodEviction
note: Pod becomes inactive/terminating; this observation alone does not kill its container.

name: OperatorCrash
note: Discard volatile reconcile progress; persisted phase/pending/target survives.

name: UpdateLeaseConfiguration
note: A legitimate admission-valid rollout. Existing runnable keeps its captured profile.

name: UpdateSynchronousConfiguration
note: Abstract validated operator-managed membership after supported cap/topology settings; no external names or direct quorum mutation.

name: RecoverEnvironment
updates: [n \in Server |-> IF n\in survivors THEN TRUE ELSE s.env.http[n]]
[n \in Server |-> IF n\in survivors THEN TRUE ELSE s.env.probe[n]]
[n \in Server |-> IF n\in survivors THEN TRUE ELSE s.env.sql[n]]
[n \in Server |-> IF n\in survivors THEN TRUE ELSE s.env.io[n]]
[n \in Server |-> IF n\in survivors THEN TRUE ELSE s.env.wal[n]]
note: Recovery suffix freezes fault injection in MC, recovers control plane and selected survivors, and does not resurrect the old primary or failed selected target.

name: ClockTick
updates: [n\in Server |-> [s.inst[n] EXCEPT !.acquireAge=IF s.inst[n].pc="acquireWait" THEN Inc(@) ELSE @]]

[n\in Server |-> [s.elect[n] EXCEPT !.observeAge=IF s.elect[n].observed THEN Inc(@) ELSE @, !.takeoverAge=IF s.elect[n].takeoverObserved THEN Inc(@) ELSE @, !.pollAge=IF s.elect[n].captured>0 THEN Inc(@) ELSE @, !.renewAge=IF s.elect[n].mode="renew" THEN Inc(@) ELSE @]]
[n\in Server |-> [s.life[n] EXCEPT !.graceAge=IF s.life[n].cancelled THEN Inc(@) ELSE @, !.stopAge=IF s.life[n].phase#"none" THEN Inc(@) ELSE @]]
note: One time unit; elapsed clocks saturate above every decision threshold. Clock progress is not a finite fault budget.

name: DeliverOperatorCluster
note: The operator retains a real informer object separately from its per-loop copy.

name: Reconcile_APIError
note: A failed write returns/requeues; it cannot later succeed using the abandoned call.

name: MarkOldPrimaryAsUnhealthy_Error
note: Best-effort label failure does not block the initial failover; the transition guard retries next pass.

name: InstanceReconcile_APIError
note: Non-conflict API errors return to reconcile; already completed promotion is retained.

name: GetSynchronousReplicationMetadata_Error
note: Unavailable SQL metadata returns an error rather than publishing invented state.
